note: ONE SHOT: eight 8-second Veo 3.1 clips chained end-frame to start-frame. Prompts: docs/cinematic/SCENES.md. The page probes each 'base' for .webm/.mp4 (video) and .jpg (still); a scene with neither is skipped. 'window' is in landing chapter units (chapter index + progress). Modes: 'handoff' plays once then dissolves into the live world; 'scrub' ties the frame to the scroll position; 'inline' clips play in order inside the Same Ground chapter.

scenes.name: Arrival
scenes.role: Hero: from black space to the lunar south pole; dissolves into the live measured Moon.

scenes.name: The Twin
scenes.role: Into chapter 1: lunar craters become a Death Valley salt pan in one move.

scenes.name: Return
scenes.role: Into chapter 2: the sky drains to black, back on a lunar crater rim.

scenes.name: Passage
scenes.role: Moon to Mars through the dust.

scenes.name: Jezero
scenes.role: Chapter 3: the delta at the blue sunset, pure cinema.

scenes.name: The Pointing
scenes.role: Opens the Same Ground chapter: Mars was a model on a table; a hand points at the crater.

scenes.name: The Answer
scenes.role: The model turns into Earth; the finger rests on the twin. Then the live comparison.

scenes.name: Home
scenes.role: Finale: from the model into real Earth and up to orbit, the Moon above the limb.
